policy: A tuple quarantined on 2026-09-07 never returns as it was. A new row for the same player, season and club is written only from new research recorded here, with club, goals and appearances each carried by two independent non-wiki hosts. Assists are null (shown n/a) unless two sources agree on them, and market value is 0 (shown n/a) unless two sources agree on it (the Round 784 convention). A 2024-2025 row found to be a mid-season snapshot is corrected through changed, field by field, each new value two-sourced and each old value guarded in the migration.

convention.split: A new spell at a European or Saudi club is written 2025-2026.
convention.calendar: A new spell at a calendar league club (MLS, Brazil, Argentina, Japan) is written as the calendar year 2025, after the precedent of Giroud 2025 LAFC.
convention.never: Nothing is written 2026. Only a plain hyphen joins the years.
convention.held: A man whose legacy rows at a calendar league club are split style gets no new row at a calendar league club until a relabel round decides what those rows mean; he is listed under held. A new row at a European or Saudi club is added all the same (the lead's decision 2 of Round 1017 for Endrick at Real Madrid and Lyon; Estêvão at Chelsea is added on the same reading, which the lead still has to accept).
convention.stats: Appearances and goals are all competitions club totals for the season (league, domestic cups, Europe and the super cup), the convention the bake's completed seasons follow. National team games are never counted.
convention.midSeason: A mid-season move is two rows with the same season string, appended in date order.
convention.clubWorldCup: The 2025 FIFA Club World Cup (June to July 2025) counts in season 2024-2025, where footballdatabase.eu, besoccer, soccerbase and Transfermarkt file it. A man who played it for a new club gets a 2024-2025 row at that club, sourced (Trent Alexander-Arnold at Real Madrid).
convention.inserted: A spell of 2024-2025 the pool never carried (a mid-season move, or the Club World Cup at a new club) is an inserted row, placed directly before or after one existing row named by season and club as it reads once the changed entries are applied.
convention.club: A 2024-2025 row filed under the wrong club is a changed entry with field club; every changed entry names its row by the club it read before the ledger, and the migration guards the new season and club key as free.
convention.noGames: A spell without a game gets no row (Raheem Sterling at Chelsea in 2025-2026).
convention.assists: Assists two hosts agree on are written; where two disagree a third host may settle it (each shard recorded which); a null a shard wrote stays null, and nobody picks between two disagreeing sources.
